apps.localizedDescription: A native iOS app for discovering comics and illustrations, enjoying them, and building your own collection. Connect your own sites, organize bookmarks and folders, translate text in images, and back up both libraries in one JSON file. Supports Korean, English and Japanese.

versions.localizedDescription: 1.0.0 (13): unified website setup with automatic mode detection, clearer onboarding and imports, smoother reverse scrolling, connection recovery and VPN/HTTPS bypass troubleshooting. TestFlight is the recommended update channel.

Hotfix 1.0.0 (8): updated splash artwork and app icon; fixes for Mac startup, Apple image translation, missing thumbnails and recent-first automatic metadata filling with a dismissible heat notice for batches of 100 or more.
Public beta 1.0.0 (7). Unified library backups, appearance-aware splash artwork, saved server discovery and improved comic page prefetching.
